title: mcywilizacja.pl
description: Built for the mcywilizacja.pl private server, this pack has something for everyone. Engineers, builders, and survivalists alike will find rich landscapes and exciting challenges to explore.
body:
![mCywilizacja.pl logo, showing 4 admins and a potential player over the name of the server](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f355c575d7e5cc8bf37fc562c442775c80485b61.png)

# mCywilizacja.pl
**Creative engineering, cozy survival and shared worldbuilding.**

Welcome to the mCywilizacja.pl modpack, built for players on the private mcywilizacja.pl Minecraft server. This pack combines technical Create gameplay, atmospheric survival, decorative building, farming, exploration and roleplay-friendly tools.

Version 5.0.0 moves the pack to **Minecraft 1.21.1** on **NeoForge**, with **Create: Aeronautics** becoming the new centerpiece for large-scale engineering. Build factories, moving contraptions, flying machines, workshops, cozy homes, towns and questionable mechanical inventions with friends.

Create and its addons are still the heart of the pack, now joined by the [Let's Do] ecosystem, Farmer's Delight, Quark, seasonal survival, expanded biomes, wildlife, NPC tools and decorative mods that make the world feel lived-in.

We're continuing the spirit of a decade-old roleplaying server: collaborative creativity, cozy survival and ambitious engineering in one multiplayer world.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.x
- Client pack for the mcywilizacja.pl server

## Main features

- Create 6 with Create: Aeronautics
- Many Create addons for building, transport, decoration and automation
- Cozy farming, cooking and decoration through Farmer's Delight and [Let's Do]
- Expanded biomes, villages, wildlife and exploration
- Seasons and survival mechanics
- JourneyMap, Easy NPC and multiplayer-friendly utility mods

The exact dependency list is included in the Modrinth version export. Major included mods include:

**Create and addons**
Create, Create: Aeronautics, Sable, Create: Bells & Whistles, Create: Copycats+, Create: Connected, Create Crafts & Additions, Create Deco, Create: Diesel Generators, Create Encased, Create Goggles, Create: Interiors, Create: Numismatics, Create Stuff & Additions, Create Unlimited, Create: Central Kitchen, Create: Dragons Plus, Create: Easy Structures, Create: Bits 'n' Bobs, Create: Structures, Create: Let The Adventure Begin, Create Man of Many Planes, Man of Many Planes and Steam 'n' Rails NeoForge.

**Survival, world and building**
Biomes O' Plenty, Terralith, Serene Seasons, Tough As Nails, Farmer's Delight, Quark, Carry On, FallingTree, Burnt Basic, Handcrafted, Immersive Aircraft, Lucky's Wardrobe and JourneyMap.

**[Let's Do] ecosystem**
Bakery, Beachparty, BloomingNature, Brewery, Camping, Candlelight, Farm & Charm, Furniture, HerbalBrews, Meadow, Vinery and WilderNature.

**Creatures and roleplay**
Creeper Overhaul, Critters and Companions, Enderman Overhaul, Ribbits and Easy NPC.

**Libraries and dependencies**
Architectury API, Cloth Config API, Curios API, Geckolib, GlitchCore, Resourceful Config, Resourceful Lib, TerraBlender, YUNG's API and Zeta.

They were all made by some very talented people and have been made available for us to use free of charge so give them some love if you can.
